Short Bio: Janine van Wyk
Football (Defender / Center-back)

Janine van Wyk is a monumental figure in South African football, widely revered as one of the greatest defenders to ever wear the national colors. A true servant of the game, she holds the remarkable distinction of being South Africa's most-capped footballer in history, amassing over 180 appearances for Banyana Banyana. Throughout her legendary career, she was the rock at the back, known for her commanding presence, crunching tackles, and powerful free-kicks. video_title: STILLE NAG in Moana Styl (Afrikaanse Kerslied Cover) 🇿🇦
description:
🌊 STILLE NAG IN DIE STYL VAN MOANA 🎶

🌙 Stille Nag (Silent  (Afrikaanse weergawe geïnspireer deur die magiese oseaanvibes van Disney se “Moana”)
Hierdie lied is pure vrede, heilige rustigheid en daai diep oseaan-kalmte wat jou laat voel asof die sterre en die see saam sing. “Stille Nag” word hier hergebore met Polinesiese ritmes, sagte tromme, oseaan-golwe op die agtergrond en ’n koor wat soos die voorvaders se stemme klink – net soos in Moana se epiese liedere. Dit bou stadig op met harmonieë, ukelele-agtige klanke en ’n hemelse vrouestem wat die heilige nag oor die eilande laat sweef.
Dis nie net ’n Kerslied nie. Dis ’n Afrikaanse ode aan die stil oseaan-nag waar die lig van die hemel die donker see verlig, en die geboorte van die Redder voel soos ’n nuwe reis oor die horison. 🌙✨
As jy al daai vibe gevoel het waar die see jou roep in die nag, en die sterre vertel van wonder en vrede, gaan hierdie een jou tref — reg in die siel.

🎧 Luister met oorfone aan. Volume sag vir die volle oseaan-rus. 🌺 Dink aan ’n Polinesiese eiland onder die sterrehemel. ❤️ Stille nag… laat die golwe dit dra.

For daily videos leading up to Christmas and a chance to vote on the next song for us to cover you can join the MLT Club here: https://monalisa-twins.com/mltclub/ 
We recorded and filmed “Time In A Bottle” during the first week of the MLT Club Advent Calendar. Our members voted for this beautiful song!

Each day, we documented the progress and showed it in a little video. From figuring out the guitar chords, to coming up with an arrangement, to finding a good filming location and then editing the video … we took the Club along for the whole very busy week!

Now we’re already working on the next pick, ”Daydream Believer" by The Monkees! If you want to be part of this Advent Calendar journey and help choose the final 3rd song, join the Club! :-)

There’ll also be a Club-exclusive Livestream on the 23rd with live music, giveaways, games and lots of chatting!

And, of course, you'll get to rewatch the past year's advent calendars, all the hundreds of behind-the-scenes videos, travel vlogs, reaction videos, vinyl listening sessions and photos posts we did over the years.

Thanks and groovy Christmas season!

Edelweiss  - The Sound Of Music Soundtrack Cover

-------------------

Did you know that “Edelweiss” is the national flower of Austria? It grows high up in the mountains in the Alps and is a “protected species”, so you are not allowed to pick it if you are lucky enough to encounter one in the wild.

When the song-writing team Rodgers and Hammerstein composed the music for the musical “Sound Of Music” they composed “Edelweiss” from scratch. So contrary to what a lot of people think it is not actually a traditional Austrian folk song and was purely written for the 1959 musical. But it could be and we like it! Seeing as we two are Austrians, it seemed right to cover it, don’t you think?

description:
Jacobus (Koos) Johannes du Plessis (10 May 1945 – 15 January 1984) was a prominent South African singer-songwriter and poet, colloquially known as Koos Doep. Although he received critical acclaim for much of his work, he became best known for the runaway success of a rendition of his song "Kinders van die Wind" ("Children of the Wind") by Laurika Rauch.

Koos du Plessis was born in Rustenburg. He was the oldest of five children, and grew up in the mining town of Springs. After school, he attended the University of Pretoria, and the University of the Witwatersrand, majoring in Afrikaans-Nederlands (Afrikaans-Dutch). At university he met his future wife, Mornay. The couple had three daughters, Irma, Karen and Karla. Koos would eventually write a song for each of these four women in his life.

Koos worked as journalist and editor for several Afrikaans publications (Oggendblad, Die Vaderland, Die Nataller and Die Transvaler). He died in a motorcar accident close to Krugersdorp during the early morning hours of 15 January 1984.
Legacy in Afrikaans
In 2010 two Koos du Plessis tribute albums were released in The Netherlands posthumously. First was Ofschaaid Zunder Woorden, an album with songs of Du Plessis sung in Grunnegs by Wia Buze and Klaas Spekken. Karla du Plessis joined for a special duet on this album. Second was Die Land Van Blou Saffiere, released in the Tussen Kontinente-series. This release was a hardcover book that included a biography, lyrics with footnotes and explanations and a CD with 20 of his songs. He wrote two religious songs: Gebed (Prayer: Let me never leave this ground, let me in thy shadow stay...) and a carol Somerkersfees (Summer Christmas). The latter was incorporated into the hymnals of several Afrikaans churches.

In 1965, the song began to attract airplay at radio stations in Boston and throughout Florida. The growing airplay led Tom Wilson, the song's producer, to remix the track, overdubbing electric instruments and drums. This remixed version was released as a single in September 1965. The remix hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 for the week ending January 1, 1966, leading the duo to reunite and hastily record their second album, which Columbia titled Sounds of Silence in an attempt to capitalize on the song's success. The remixed single version of the song was included on this follow-up album. Later, it was featured in the 1967 film The Graduate and was included on the film's soundtrack album. "Seemann (Deine Heimat ist das Meer)" (English translation "Sailor (Your Home is the Sea)") is a song originally written in German by Werner Scharfenberger (de) and lyricist Fini Busch (de). A 1959 German-language recording by Lolita became an international hit in 1960–61.

The song was covered in a number of languages, most notably by Petula Clark who had her first #1 UK hit with the English-language rendering "Sailor". Clark was also afforded international success with both "Sailor" and the French-language rendering "Marin". A rival version by Anne Shelton was a Top Ten UK hit, concluding her chart career. Other singers for whom "Sailor (Your Home is the Sea)" brought success as rendered in various languages include: Scandinavian singers Thory Bernhards and Towa Carson "Sjöman" (Swedish) and Jan Høiland "Sjömann" (Norwegian); Caterina Valente, who had a Flemish hit with "Zeeman (Je verlangen is de zee)"( Dutch;) a 1981 hit in the Netherlands for Ciska Peters (nl); and Virginia Lee (af) whose "Seeman" (Afrikaans) was a successful local cover in South Africa.

description:
La Paloma cover by Dawie Lindner on Yamaha psr SX700 keybord.

"La Paloma", "The Dove" in English, is a popular Spanish song that has been produced and reinterpreted in diverse cultures, settings, arrangements, and recordings over the last 140 years. The song was composed and written by the Spanish composer from the Basque region Sebastián Iradier (later Yradier) in the 1850s. In 1879, it was registered at the copyright office in Madrid as a "Canción Americana con acompañamiento de Piano".[1] Iradier was to die in obscurity within few years, never to learn how popular his song would become.

Very quickly, "La Paloma" became popular outside of Spain, particularly in Mexico, and soon spread around the world. In many places, including Afghanistan, Cuba, Colombia, Hawaii, the Philippines, Germany, Romania, Venezuela, Zanzibar, and Goa it gained the status of a quasi-folk song. Over the years, the popularity of "La Paloma" has surged and receded periodically, but never subsided. It may be considered one of the first universal popular hits and has appealed to artists of diverse musical backgrounds. There are more than one thousand versions of this song, and together with "Yesterday" by The Beatles, is one of the most-recorded songs in the history of music; it is certainly the most-recorded Spanish song.

description:
A heartfelt cross-cultural tribute connecting the soulful sounds of Joy Denalane with the timeless South African lullaby tradition. We explore the emotional depth of "Süsser Freund" and "Slaap My Kindjie," blending German soul with Afrikaans heritage. ✨🌍
Fun Facts to Connect Themes 💡
Soul Bridges: Joy Denalane is a pioneer of German Soul, often blending her heritage into her music, much like how this cover blends Afrikaans and German lullabies 🎶🇿🇦🇩🇪.

The Lullaby Connection: "Slaap My Kindjie" is the Afrikaans version of Brahms' Lullaby, which shares its structural DNA with the "Guten Abend, gut’ Nacht" featured in German classical lieder 🌹💤.

video_title: 🇿🇦 Sarie Marais: A Tribute to Mimi Coertse & The Legacy of Virginia Davids
description:
A deep-dive cover of the classic "Sarie Marais," performed as a heartfelt tribute to the legendary Mimi Coertse. 🎭 This rendition honors the lineage of South African vocal excellence—from Virginia Davids’ iconic 1994 performance at the State Theatre to the global stages of the MET with Pretty Yende. 🎵 Exploring the history of the "Grootrivier" through a modern, textured lens. 🌊✨

Fun Facts

Vocal Lineage: Virginia Davids, a powerhouse of the Black Tie Ensemble, mentored Pretty Yende, who eventually took that South African brilliance to the Metropolitan Opera (MET). 🏛️✨

The "Grootrivier": The lyrics mention "Upington se sand," referring to the Orange River (Grootrivier). Upington was a vital refuge and remains a symbol of the rugged Northern Cape landscape. 🍇🏜️

Sarie Marais: While known as a folk song, it’s actually a story of longing and displacement, making the dry, atmospheric textures of this cover a perfect fit for the "Upington sand" theme. 📜💨

video_title: The Strumbellas - David (Multi-Instrument Cover by Mr A)
description:
So it has been about a week since I've uploaded my "goodbye" video, and here I'm officially saying, I'm back in business!

I'm going to keep that video up because it did mark the end of the first chapter of this channel. 

This new chapter will include a lot of pop, rock and worship music. I'm moving away from most metal music, in particular metal that resembles the occult. 

For a long time, I thought that lyrics don't affect me in any way. But the truth is, there is power in the words that we speak and listen to, and I'm choosing not to expose myself or any of my viewers with lyrics of that destructive nature.

I'm not saying metal is completely banned from my channel. The best solos and riffs are found in metal music, and I will continue to highlight that aspect of the genre!

I'm also planning to release much more original music, so stay tuned for that!

Regards
Mr A

video_title: You’re The Voice - Perpetuum Jazzile (#stayathome corona quarantine videocall vocal orchestra cover)
description:
Creative: 37 Singers' STAY-AT-HOME Shout Out!

Dear Coronavirus, 
Here's a message from Perpetuum Jazzile: “We're not gonna sit in silence, we're not gonna live with fear! This time we know we all can stand together. With the power to be powerful, believin' we can make it better.” // Koronavirus, tule imaš sporočilo Perpetuum Jazzile: "Ne bomo sedeli v tišini in ne bomo živeli v strahu. Tokrat vemo, da lahko vsi stopimo skupaj. Z močjo najmočnejših in z zaupanjem, da bomo vse to presegli."

Dear friends, 
This video is our response to the situation we're all facing and a gift to you all. Since we're amidst preparation for a new show, but following the rule: STAY AT HOME unable to get together to rehearse, we got another idea how to harmonize remotely. It took literally 3 days to pull this off – first using our phones at home, then every singer's audio and video footage was put together – and we are pretty pleased with the result. What do you think? // Dragi prijatelji! Ta video je naš odgovor na situacijo, v kateri smo se vsi skupaj znašli, in naše darilo vsem vam. ker smo sredi priprav na nov show, a moramo slediti zapovedi OSTANI DOMA, zaradi česar ne moremo na skupne vaje, smo prišli na idejo, da bi se uglasili na daljavo. Trajalo je vsega 3 dni, da smo ta posnetek izpeljali - in kar zadovoljni smo z rezultatom. Kaj menite?

With the song "You're The Voice" we want to connect people in self-isolation around the world, inspire them with music and remind them that every person is a voice of reason that can make a change. Let's go! // S skladbo "You're The Voice" ("Ti si glas") želimo povezati vse ljudi v samoizolaciji po svetu, jih navdihniti z našo glasbo in nas vse spomniti, da vsak človek lahko predstavlja glas razuma, ki pripelje do spremembe. Dajmo! 

Stay strong and #stayathome! // Ostanimo močni in DOMA!

***

description:

Not my best rendition - a few timing issues,(maar nou ja...) but enjoy the effort of added chords with lyrics. Earphones on full volume might be helpful as the upload seems 'soft' for some reason
And no, that's not a fart near the end of the video :-)
I wouldn't have a clue what this song is about but the visual poetry of the lyrics and quirky character names makes it interesting. I enjoy playing it from time to time. If you DO know what this song is about, feel free to share it with us as there's not a lot on the web about it. Thanks for watching and hope you enjoyed. 

Update: 24 January 2014. Duroc = rare breed of pig.

                                                  A village in Poland

video_title: Hey Baby - Refiloe Jane Tribute | SA Heroes Series (LeLi Cover)
description:
Onstuitbaar op die sokkerveld en 'n ware inspirasie vir die hele land! In hierdie episode van ons SA Heldenaarsreeks vier ons die briljante Refiloe Jane—kaptein, stryder en trots van Banyana Banyana.

Om hulde te bring aan haar energie en impak, gee ons 'n unieke, vrolike en sielvolle draai aan DJ Ötzi se klassieker "Hey Baby", met 'n spesiale tweetalige (Afrikaans en isiXhosa) verwerking wat elke hart laat saamsing:

Hey, hey mntwana... Ndifuna ukwazi... Ukuba uya kuba yintombi yam...
Hey, hey baba... Ek wil weet... Of jy my meisie sal wees...

Gemaak in ons kenmerkende 9:16-formaat met 'n warm, vintage esteties vir die gemeenskap.

#RefiloeJane #HeyBaby #BanyanaBanyana #SAHeldene #SuidAfrika #Sokker #LeLiCover #Afrikaans #IsiXhosa #OldiesVocalCovers

video_title: Maak gereed vir hoendervleis! Gerda Steyn Tribute | Sarie Marais (Mimi Sings)
description:
Maak gereed vir hoendervleis! In hierdie spesiale Vrouedag-uitgawe van ons SA Heldenaarsreeks bring ons hulde aan die merkwaardige Gerda Steyn—die onstuitbare koningin van die Comrades en die pad wat ons almal met trots vervul. Haar uithouvermoë en passie is 'n inspirasie vir elke Suid-Afrikaner.

Om hierdie eerbetoon te kroon, bring Mimi Sings 'n diep ontroerende, akustiese vertolking van die klassieke volksliedjie "Sarie Marais", gevul met nostalgie en egte landswydse trots.

Gemaak met 'n warm, vintage esteties en 'n egte 9:16-visuele styl vir ons gemeenskap.

#GerdaSteyn #Vrouedag #SarieMarais #MimiSings #SAHeldene #Afrikaans #ComradesMarathon #SuidAfrika #Hoendervleis #OldiesVocalCovers

Τόσα χρόνια μες στους χάρτες μου σε ψάχνω, 
κι ας μην έσκυψες ποτέ στο μέτωπό μου με τα δυο σου χείλια 
ν' αφήσεις μια ανάσα στη ζωή μου. 
Κι αν η προσευχή μου οινόπνευμα μυρίζει, καπνό και πυρετό, 
στο γυάλινο το κύμα τ' όνομά σου 
φωνάζω να καθρεφτιστεί η φωνή μου. 

Και στην όχθη που χτενίζεσαι ακούστει σαν αλμυρό 
τραγούδι που σου φέρνει ερωτευμένο το νερό. 
Και στο διάβολο πουλάω τη ψυχή μου εγώ, για να βρεθώ 
απόψε τυλιγμένος στου κορμιού σου το βυθό. 

Κάπου η νύχτα μεσοπέλαγα κρεμιέται στην αγχόνη τ' ουρανού 
κι ο δαίμονας καβάλα στο σκοτάδι 
αρπάζει τη μετέωρη ευχή μου. 
Και σαν άστρο καυτερό προς το νησί σου τα λόγια μου πετάει πληγώνοντας τα βράχια και την άμμο, 
στη χτένα σου καρφώνει την ψυχή μου. 

Και σταγόνα τη σταγόνα κυλάω εγώ σαν αλμυρό 
νερό στους ώμους και στον ακριβό σου το λαιμό. 
Κι ας το ξέρω πως του λόγου του στην ανεμόσκαλα εκεί, 
με περιμένει για να μου λιμάρει το σκοινί. 

Πάνε χρόνια που αντίκρυ αναβοσβήνουν τα φώτα κάποιας γης, 
τα φώτα κάποιας ξεχασμένης νήσου, 
που λένε είν' οι κορφές του παραδείσου. 
Μα το ξέρω είναι της θάλασσας τα μάγια, δεν υπάρχει αυτή η στεριά, 
μιας και κανείς ποτέ του εκεί δεν πήγε, 
γι' αυτό σφιχτά κρατιέμαι στο κορμί σου. 

Και μπροστά απ' τους κολασμένους περνάω εγώ σαν μια σκιά 
που σεργιανάει στον Άδη τη δικιά σου μυρωδιά. 
Κι είναι λέω ο παράδεισος για μας, αγάπη μου μικρή, 
να μοιραζόμαστε τούτη τη κόλαση μαζί.

video_title: The Ballad of the Green Berets Cover Dawie Lindner
description:
"The Ballad of the Green Berets" is a patriotic song in the ballad style about the United States Army Special Forces. It is one of the few popular songs of the Vietnam War years to cast the military in a positive light. In 1966 it became a major hit, reaching No. 1 for five weeks on the Hot 100 and four weeks on Cashbox. It was also a crossover hit, reaching No. 1 on Billboard's Easy Listening chart and No. 2 on Billboard's Country survey. Billboard ranked it No. 10 in its year-end chart for 1966,[3] while it tied for first with "California Dreamin'" by the Mamas and the Papas in Cash Box's year-end rankings.[4]

The song was written by then-Staff Sergeant or "SSG" Barry Sadler, beginning when he was training to be a Special Forces medic. The author Robin Moore, who wrote the book The Green Berets, helped Sadler write the lyrics and get a recording contract with RCA Records. The demo of the song was produced in a rudimentary recording studio at Fort Liberty, with the help of Gerry Gitell and LTG William P. Yarborough.[5]

The lyrics were written, in part, in honor of U.S. Army Specialist 5 James Gabriel Jr., a Special Forces operator and the first native Hawaiian to die in Vietnam, who was killed by Viet Cong gunfire while on a training mission with the South Vietnamese Army on April 8, 1962.[6] One verse mentioned Gabriel by name, but it was not used in the recorded version.[7]

Sadler recorded the song and eleven other tunes in New York in December 1965. The song and album, Ballads of the Green Berets, were released in January 1966. He performed the song on television on January 30, 1966 on The Ed Sullivan Show, and on other TV shows including Hollywood Palace and The Jimmy Dean Show.

video_title: Ek verlang na jou   Cover   Dawie Lindner Yamaha psr SX700
description:
Sonja Herholdt 
Herholdt was born in the small Gauteng mining village of Nigel and at the age of three made her first singing performance at the local community recreation hall, singing the Afrikaans lullaby Slaap, my Kindjie.

She attended the Afrikaans-medium Tini Vorster Primary and Hoërskool John Vorster where she became Head Girl in both and followed her theatrical pursuits.

Career
Her breakthrough came when she did a spot on Gwynneth Ashley Robin's show and was soon asked to record Ek Verlang Na Jou.[2] The single went gold in South Africa, selling over 25 000 copies.[3]

Her subsequent albums and singles earned her similar critical and commercial success. She went on to win a total of eight Sarie awards.[2] In the 1970s and 1980s, she was frequently the best-selling female artist in South Africa.[2]

In 1979, she finally fulfilled her ambition to act by starring in Sing vir die Harlekyn, and winning a Rapport Oscar-Award as Best Female Newcomer.[1]

She later enjoyed music success in Europe, she holds the distinction of being the first ever South African singer to be invited to perform in the Netherlands on their local Television.[6] She recorded her song Oberammergau in Dutch. She also performed in Belgium, pushing Oberammergau into fifth place in the Belgian charts.[3]

In 1989, she performed at the Religious Broadcasting Corporation in Washington, coinciding with the release of her gospel album, The Warrior is a Child.[3]

In 1991, she received an award from the Afrikaans Chamber of Commerce for her services to Afrikaans music.[2]

In 1995, she signed an album contract with BMG Records, enjoying success with the title track of her new BMG compilation, Skipskop. Her 1998 album Ritsel in die Rietbos did not meet critical and commercial expectations. But she rebounded with the critically acclaimed 2000 album, Reconstructing Alice.[3]

In 2002 she developed her own record company, Son Music and released Sonjare, a nostalgic retrospective of her original hits

video_title: Ein Stern - Cover Dawie Lindner
description:
Ein Stern (... that bears your name) is a hit song by the Austrian singer Nikolaus Presnik alias Nik P. from 1998. It became a hit in the party hit version by the Austrian singer DJ Ötzi together with Nik P. in the German-speaking countries and leads (together with Butterfly by Danyel Gérard ) the all-time list of the most successful singles in German chart history (256 points each). 

The song was written and composed by Nikolaus Presnik in 1998. Interpreted by Michael Stern , it took part in the Grand Prix des Schlagers in the same year and reached tenth place there.

It was widely played in Mallorca 's club scene at the end of 2006 , bringing it to new prominence as a party hit . It was then released in February 2007 in the version by DJ Ötzi together with Nik P. as the first single from DJ Ötzi's album Sternstunden and reached number one in the German and Austrian charts and number two in the Swiss charts .  Four years after the success of the Burger Dance , DJ Ötzi scored another number one hit in Germany with Ein Stern and , after Anton from Tirol (1999), his second hit, which also appeared inAustria reached number one in the charts .

With 108 weeks in the German charts, it is one of the songs that stayed in the German singles charts the longest . At the time of publication, he set a new record. It was also the first piece to be in the German charts for more than two years. In the RTL channel 's Ultimate Chart Show , the song was placed at number 1 of the "most successful songs of the new millennium". 

With more than 1.2 million units sold, the single has been certified four times platinum in Germany, making it one of the best-selling German hits and one of the best-selling singles in Germany in general . 

Even before DJ Ötzi and Nik P. released the song together, the Duisburg singer Nic was able to place himself in the single charts with his version Eine Stern .

video_title: Sewen Spanish Angels   Cover   Dawie Lindner
description:
"Seven Spanish Angels" is a song written by Troy Seals and Eddie Setser, and recorded by Ray Charles as a duet with Willie Nelson. It was released in November 1984 as a single from Charles' 1984 album Friendship. Charles and Nelson split the verses, with Charles singing the first and Nelson the second, Charles sang the first and second choruses with Nelson joining for the outro. It was also included on Nelson's 1985 compilation album Half Nelson. "Seven Spanish Angels" was the most successful of Charles' eight hits on the country chart. The single spent one week at number one and a total of twelve weeks on the country chart.

Setser had suggested the title "Seven Spanish Angels" and he and Seals had written the song as a homage to the tejano flavored classic hits of Marty Robbins exemplified by Robbins' career record "El Paso" (Troy Seals quote): "When we finished it we thought 'Who in the world's gonna do it?' because Marty was [deceased]." Within two days "Seven Spanish Angels" had been successfully pitched to Willie Nelson. Before Nelson was able to record it, producer Billy Sherrill happened to hear the demo and wanted the song for Ray Charles. Sherrill proposed that Nelson and Charles duet on the song after learning of Nelson's having reserved it.

video_title: I'd Love You to Want Me   Cover   Dawie Lindner Yamaha psr SX700
description:
"I'd Love You to Want Me" is a song by American singer-songwriter Lobo. It was released in September 1972 as the second single from his second album Of a Simple Man.

The song was Lobo's highest charting hit on the Billboard Hot 100 chart, where it spent two weeks at No. 2 in November. The single was the second of four of his songs to hit No. 1 on the Easy Listening chart, where it had a one-week stay at that top spot in December 1972. It became a gold record.

When released in the United Kingdom in 1972, the song failed to reach the UK Singles Chart; however, a re-release of the single in 1974, on the UK record label, peaked at No. 5.

The song also topped the music charts in at least seven nations, including Australia (Kent Music Report, two weeks), Canada (RPM Magazine, one week), and Germany (Media Control Charts, 13 weeks in 1973-1974).

"Hallelujah" is a song written by Canadian singer Leonard Cohen, originally released on his album Various Positions (1984). Achieving little initial success, the song found greater popular acclaim through a new version recorded by John Cale in 1991, which inspired a recording of Cale's version by Jeff Buckley in 1994.

Following its increased popularity after being featured in the film Shrek (2001), many other arrangements have been performed in recordings and in concert, with over 300 versions known. The song has been used in film and television soundtracks and televised talent contests. "Hallelujah" experienced renewed interest following Cohen's death in November 2016 and appeared on many international singles charts, including entering the American Billboard Hot 100 for the first time.

video_title: Mama Leone Cover Dawie Lindner Yamaha psr SX700
description:
Bino first studied architecture in order to take over his father's company. He returned to Italy and came back to Germany in 1975 as a musician, first to Schopfheim in the Black Forest. In nearby Bad Säckingen he became a member of the existing group "I Figli Di Yuma" with which he toured the region and through Switzerland. Then he came to Oldenburg, where he once worked as an ice cream vendor, sometimes as a singer at festivals and on to Hamburg, where producer Rainer Felsen from Pino Music first took notice of him.

In 1978, working with Drafi Deutscher and Mike Mareen, Bino composed and recorded Mama Leone.

Bino landed his biggest success in 1978 with the song Mama Leone, with music composed by Drafi Deutscher and Mike Mareen. The song was recorded in an Italian with lyrics by Bino as well as a German version. For eight weeks it was number 1 on the charts in Austria, and four weeks at the top position on the Swiss charts. On 23 November 1978 both versions were in the top 10 on the German charts. The Mama Leone album sold 20 million copies worldwide. In 1997 he dedicated his song to the late Catholic nun Mother Teresa. He later had two minor hits with the songs Bambino (18th in Germany) and Maria (25th place in Germany), both written by Drafi Deutscher.

For some years Bino lived with his girlfriend Katrin on Mallorca in Spain. He died at the age of 57 in Palermo with cancer.

#SAEDM
🌙 ’n Lied oor aantrekking wat brand, breek… en bly  
Hierdie song vang daai gevoel van iemand wat jou heeltyd intrek en weer wegstoot — die tipe liefde wat jou laat voel soos tequila op ’n leë maag: warm, roekeloos, verslawend.

Van laatnag-oomblikke en sout op jou lippe, tot branders wat breek soos twee mense wat nie kan ophou terugkom na mekaar toe nie… dis ’n storie van verlange, beheer verloor, en die een waarheid wat bly staan:

“Jy weet jy’s mooi vir my.”

💫 Wat om te verwag:

Intieme, beeldryke Afrikaans lirieke

’n Melodie wat jou vat van skemerstrande tot middernag-drome

Emosie wat bou, breek, en weer opstaan

’n Refrain wat in jou kop vassteek lank nadat die lied klaar is

As hierdie song jou tref, laat weet my in die comments watter lyn jou die hardste getref het.
En moenie vergeet om te like, subscribe, en deel met iemand wat steeds mooi vir jou is.

video_title: Do it Anyway - Alex Boye' Ft. Carmen Rasmusen Herbert (Vegas Tribute)
description:
CARMEN

My husband and I were just there-at Mandalay Bay-only a few days before. We watched a show. We walked the strip. Had a great time.

 Days later, I woke up to an alert on my phone-Breaking News on the Las Vegas mass shooting. For a second I wondered if I was still dreaming-this couldn’t really be happening again. My heart hurt. I felt sick. And I didn’t want to get out of bed. My husband and I said a prayer together and throughout the morning a song kept playing in my head: “Anyway” by Martina McBride. The lyrics struck me in a way they never had and I had a thought to call my friend Alex Boye’ and record it. Right away. I always wonder “What can I do?” when disaster strikes. I always pray for comfort and healing, but I wanted to do more. To share some of what I was feeling in the best way I knew how-by singing. I hope that whoever listens to this will feel some tiny ray of hope, that when horrible things happen, you fight, you stay strong, you still dream, you still love, you still sing. This world can be so dark and it’s hard to believe the light will continue to shine. Believe it anyway.

ALEX 
What lies in the heart of a person who chooses to take 50+ lives at a concert, and was clearly hoping to have taken many more? Condolences to the families of these innocent victims who's lives will now have changed forever. “Die Gelofte” is ’n Afrikaanse rock-lied deur Kuber Kris, geïnspireer deur die oorspronklike Gelofte wat in 1838 voor die Slag van Bloedrivier afgelê is. Hierdie weergawe bring die woorde en betekenis van die Gelofte na vandag—met kragtige rock-klanke, rou emosie en ’n diep eerbied vir ons geskiedenis.

Mental illness is a mental battle of the mind that is all too real. Studies suggests that approximately 1 in 5 people experience mental illness in a given year. ABOUT THE VIDEO:

They thought they were only coming to the premiere of Michael… but then the legendary sound of “Thriller” filled the cinema.

At the grand Slovenian premiere of Michael, the highly anticipated film about the life and music of the King of Pop, the audience in Ljubljana’s Odiseja cinema got an unforgettable surprise even before the movie began.

Members of Perpetuum Jazzile were secretly sitting among the audience. As Michael Jackson’s iconic “Thriller” started playing, they rose from their seats one by one, microphones in hand, and slowly made their way toward the stage like zombies while performing the legendary moves inspired by the original music video.  

What started as a regular movie premiere turned into a full cinema flashmob tribute to one of the most influential artists of all time. The audience had no idea what was coming — and their reaction says it all.

Performed by: Perpetuum Jazzile
Song: Thriller – Michael Jackson
Arrangement: Samo Vovk
Location: Odiseja, Ljubljana, Slovenia
Occasion: Slovenian premiere of Michael

The earliest vocal version was recorded by Freddy Quinn in 1965 titled as "Spanish Eyes"; soon after its release, the single was pulled from the market when Polydor (Quinn's label) and Decca (Kaempfert's label) threatened to sue, claiming ownership of the song.
A version by Sergio Franchi with lyrics by Charles Singleton was recorded in late 1965 titled "Moon Over Naples", but did not chart.
It was a hit single in 1966 for Al Martino when a new set of lyrics were written by composer Eddie Snyder, now titled "Spanish Eyes". (All subsequent versions used this title, and now listed both Singleton and Snyder among the credits.) Released in late 1965 in the United States, this recording reached number 15 on the Billboard Hot 100[2] and spent four weeks atop the Billboard Easy Listening chart[3] in early 1966. This vocal version was also a hit in Europe, where it sold an estimated 800,000 copies in Germany[3] and made the UK Singles Chart twice, peaking at number 49 in 1970 and then reaching number five in August 1973.[4]
Andy Williams released a version in 1967 on his album, Born Free.
A cover by Willie Nelson and Julio Iglesias peaked at number 8 on the Billboard Hot Country Singles chart in 1988.[5]
In 2003 the Italian accordionist Beppe Junior performs an instrumental version included in the album Liscioterapia (Europlay, CD 0189).
Little Willie Littlefield recorded a version for his 1990 album Singalong with Little Willie Littlefield.
In 2013, vocal group Il Divo recorded a duet with British singer Engelbert Humperdinck.[6] Produced by Alberto Quintero, it was included in the album Engelbert Calling released September 30, 2014.[7]

The original Nilsen Brothers Pepe Ederer (1932), Gerd Gudera (1933) and Walter Leykauf (1942) came from a village in Oberpfalz. They performed as amateur singers at small and large events and also won a talent competition of the Bayerischer Rundfunk. They were then invited to the TV show Toi, Toi, Toi, hosted by Peter Frankenfeld. After a performance in Hamburg, they received various offers from record labels, but eventually it became the Cologne label Electrola. Their first German-language single, Tom Dooley, was produced in the fall of 1958 and hit the German charts in December, where they made it to 1st place. They were also represented in the slot machine market charts with a listing of 36 weeks, the youth magazine Bravo recorded the number for 28 weeks in its Musicbox chart from December 1958 to July 1959, of which twelve times at number 1. The song was also sung in the film comedy Always those Mädchen.

Until 1961 10 singles were recorded with Electrola, including songs with Boy Berger and Angèla Durand. The title Die Cowboys von der Silver Ranch, together with Angèle Durand, hit the charts (1960, 2nd place). Further chart successes were Tom Dooley II (1960, 40th place), Sacramento (1961, 22nd place) and Stielaugen-Tango (1962, 50th place). The title Aber dich gibt's nur einmal für mich, composed by Ederer, only entered the charts in Austria (1967, 9th place). After the expiry of the contract with Electrola, there were only brief commitments with the labels Ariola, Decca Records and Philips. Only in 1965 they got a long-term contract with the Duisburg label Populär, good for more than ten single productions. In addition, they also collaborated in various films.

video_title: Stille Nag - Germandt Geldenhuys (ft. Reynardt Hugo, Clint Brink, Ben Kruger & Paul Lückhoff)
description:
ⓒ Germandt Geldenhuys
Jy kan sekerlik saamstem: 2020 was ‘n tawwe jaar wat baie van ons se hoop weg gevreet het en gevolglik gaan hierdie Kersfees dalk ‘n bietjie meer gedemp wees, vir baie mense. 
Dit is presies waaraan ek gedink het op ‘n Maandagmiddag einde November toe iemand my daaraan herinner dat daar in die stil tye van die lewe ook wonderwerke kan gebeur - dat nuwe lewe (en hoop) uit die eenvoud kan spruit. 
Ek het toe besluit ek wil “Stille Nag” (my ma se gunsteling Kerslied) opneem en vrystel oor die feestydperk.
Ek het dadelik my vriend (en maestro!), Sean Butler, genader om die opname te behartig. (Al was die “deadline” letterlik 7 dae, het hy ingestem en tot in die middernagtelike ure gewerk.) 
Sean, daar is nie baie mense soos jy nie. Jy is ongelooflik. Baie dankie.

Ek wou graag ook vir ‘n slag iets saam my vriende doen - al was dit net iets klein - en ek besluit toe om van my vriende by Binnelanders saam te nooi om te kom saamsing!
Hierdie manne het almal binne sekondes “ja” gesê toe ek dit aan hulle voorstel en elke liewe een van hulle het uit hulle pad gegaan om van hierdie projek ‘n sukses te maak. 
Dankie manne. Ek is trots om julle my vriende en kollegas te kan noem.
Saam julle sal ek oorlog toe gaan. 

Ek het ook besluit dat ek hierdie projek alles ten bate van die Abraham Kriel Kinderhuis gaan doen. So, elke keer wat jy die song aflaai, koop, speel of share, doen jy dit met die wete dat jy ‘n klomp kinders se Kersfees en Nuwe Jaar ‘n klein bietjie lekkerder gaan maak. Al die opbrengs word net so aan hulle geskenk. 

Ek hoop julle geniet - en word geraak - deur hierdie weergawe van Stille Nag deur my, (Germandt Geldenhuys), Reynardt Hugo, Clint Brink, Ben Kruger en Paul Lückhoff. 
SHARE sover as wat jy kan, asseblief. 
Hoe meer mense luister hoe meer fondse samel ons in. En sodoende versprei ons sommer ook die Kersfeesgees!

video_title: Winternag (n gedig deur Eugene Marais)
description:

Hello darkness, my old friend
I've come to talk with you again
Because a vision softly creeping
Left its seeds while I was sleeping
And the vision that was planted in my brain
Still remains
Within the sound of silence

In restless dreams I walked alone
Narrow streets of cobblestone
'Neath the halo of a street lamp
I turned my collar to the cold and damp
When my eyes were stabbed by the flash of a neon light
That split the night
And touched the sound of silence

And in the naked light I saw
Ten thousand people, maybe more
People talking without speaking
People hearing without listening
People writing songs that voices never share
And no one dared
Disturb the sound of silence

"Fools, " said I, "You do not know
Silence, like a cancer, grows
Hear my words that I might teach you
Take my arms that I might reach you"
But my words, like silent raindrops fell
And echoed in the wells, of silence

And the people bowed and prayed
To the neon god they made
And the sign flashed out its warning
In the words that it was forming
And the sign said, "The words of the prophets are written on the subway walls
And tenement halls"
And whispered in the sounds of silence

video_title: Wie Is Ek? | ’n Afrikaanse Verwerking van Charlie Pride se “Who Am I”
description:
🎵 WIE IS EK?
’n Afrikaanse verwerking, geïnspireer deur Charlie Pride se “Who Am I”

Op versoek van Miems is hierdie lied in Afrikaans verwerk — ’n besondere liedjie wat my geïnspireer het om Charlie Pride se “Who Am I” se storie en gevoel in Afrikaans te vertolk en ’n eie betekenis daaraan te gee.

Soms is jy die een wat iemand optel wanneer hulle val… die een wat daar bly wanneer hulle deur moeilike tye gaan… maar later bly daar net een vraag oor:

Wie is ek?

“Wie Is Ek?” vertel die verhaal van iemand wat alles gegee het, liefgehad het met sy hele hart en daar was toe iemand hom nodig gehad het — maar uiteindelik moet besef dat hy dalk nooit die een was wat sy hart gekies het nie.

❤️ Vir almal wat al ooit gewonder het of hulle genoeg was…

Wie is ek?

Miems, baie dankie vir jou versoek en vir die inspirasie agter hierdie Afrikaanse weergawe. ❤️

Laat weet my in die kommentaar wat hierdie lied vir jou beteken. Ek lees graag julle boodskappe.

🎧 Lirieke geskryf deur Linda Bezuidenhout
🎸 Klank en visuele elemente is digitaal geskep
🎵 Oorspronklike Afrikaanse en Engelse liedjies
💛 Liefdesliedjies, geloofsmusiek en emosionele ballades

✨ Het hierdie lied jou geraak?
👍 Like, deel en teken in op ZENLIN STUDIO.
🔔 Klik op die klokkie en kies "All" sodat jy nooit 'n nuwe lied mis nie.

video_title: Laurika se Bootjie na kammaland Gaan Viral! 🎶🦅 Kaapse Seemeeu & Koor-Magic!
description:
Maak gereed vir absolute cuteness overload! 💙 Ons vat vandag ’n bootjie na Kammaland, reg vanaf die pragtige, sonnige strande van Mosselbaai! 🏖️✨ Met ’n spesiale verskyning deur ons eie kordaat Kaapse seemeeu en ’n hele klomp Smurf-magie.

Luister fyn na Leli se diep, ritmiese gesproke woord-intro, gevolg dat die ikoniske Laurika Rauch-styl "Bootjie" wat jou reguit terug gaan vat na jou kinderdae. 🚣‍♂️ Op pad na Kammaland wag daar ’n massiewe, moderne koor-verassing op julle wat jou hoendervleis gaan gee! 🎤🔥

Los ’n 💙 as jy ook saam met ons wil weeg na die land oos van die son en wes van die maan!

🧠 FUNFACTS (Om temas te konnekteer)
🦅 Die Kaapse Seemeeu (Kelp Gull): Het jy geweet hierdie slim voëls in Mosselbaai kan tot 30 jaar oud word? Hulle is die amptelike strand-inspekteurs van die Tuinroete! 🌊

🍄 Smurfe & Kammaland: Die Smurfe woon in hulle eie paddastoel-dorpie, wat basies die perfekte Europese weergawe van ons eie sprokiesagtige Kammaland is! 💙

🚣‍♂️ Die Bootjie se Oorsprong: "As die Bootjie Wieg" is een van Suid-Afrika se oudste en mees geliefde slaaptyd- en kinderliedjies. Wanneer dit met die ryk, ikoniese tekstuur van Laurika Rauch gekombineer word, verander dit in pure emosionele goud wat generasies oorbrug. 🌟

video_title: Green Green Grass of Home // Die Pad Terug Huistoe (ft. Ella Langley & Leli) 🎸🇿🇦🇺🇸
description:
Wanneer Nashville ontmoet op die stoep van 'n Suid-Afrikaanse plaashuis. Ella Langley se "country grit" smelt saam met Leli se lae mezzo-tekstuur vir 'n gestroopte, eerlike weergawe van hierdie legende. Geen produksie-truuks nie—net 'n kitaar, 'n kers in die venster, en die reuk van vars koffie.
FUNFACTS TO CONNECT THEMES
Acoustic Revival: Hierdie weergawe fokus op die "Acoustic Revival" kanaal-tema, waar die instrumentasie gestroop is tot net die essensie van country en folk.

Country Soul Food: Die lirieke verwys na die "magic" van die kombuis—'n universele country-tema wat Nashville se koringlande verbind met die vetkoek en melktert van 'n plaaskombuis.

Vocal Texture: Leli se gebruik van vocal fry en whispers in plaas van melodiese sang skep 'n intieme, "late-night radio" gevoel wat perfek pas by die country-genre.

The idea behind this cover is bringing up the question of musical eternality. We believe that Justin Timberlake's music is just as eternal as Bach's and is here forever. This music covers Timberlake's "Cry Me A River" in a never-heard way: Creating a crossover between urban R&B / Pop and authentic baroque music inspired by J.S. Bach (motifs of Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor BWV 565 were also used as part of the arrangement). This new music concept targets both classical music lovers and popular music fans and will hopefully will bring them closer together. 

All music and sounds you hear are recorded, produced and performed by Bence, including his beatbox tracks and percussive sounds using the body of a grand piano. The classical elements and instrumental interludes were also arranged by Bence, creating over 100 different tracks, which were all mixed and mastered by him.
Interesting fact: Bence currently holds the Guinness World Record for being the "Fastest Piano Player".
